title: Vice City Field Notes
notice: Unofficial fan-made trophy concepts; not an announced or verified GTA VI trophy list.

trophies.name: A Sunlit State
trophies.description: Complete every other entry in this imagined Leonida ledger.
trophies.hint: Keep a short list of each activity category; the last few gaps are easier to spot in a clean sweep.

trophies.name: One Last Favor
trophies.description: Bring the central story to its closing chapter.
trophies.hint: Follow the main-character markers when you want to move the narrative forward.

trophies.name: Neon Hours
trophies.description: Reach the highest completion milestone in the state.
trophies.hint: Check the in-game completion breakdown between story stretches instead of saving every side activity for the end.

trophies.name: Both Sides of the Coin
trophies.description: See every major chapter through both leads' perspectives.
trophies.hint: When the game offers a character switch, look for a fresh objective before leaving the area.

trophies.name: Open Roads
trophies.description: Visit every named district and remote landmark.
trophies.hint: Trace the coastline and highway spurs; small map labels can hide easy-to-miss corners.

trophies.name: First Night, Best Night
trophies.description: Finish the opening run and make it back to the city.
trophies.hint: Stay with the active objective until the first safehouse is available.

trophies.name: Clean Break
trophies.description: Leave a complicated deal with both leads still in play.
trophies.hint: Listen for the change in mission tone before rushing toward the next marker.

trophies.name: Family Business
trophies.description: Set up a reliable base of operations for the crew.
trophies.hint: A new property or contact can unlock follow-up work; check the map after the scene.

trophies.name: Weather Eye
trophies.description: Ride through a full cycle of Leonida's changing skies.
trophies.hint: Spend time outdoors in several regions; conditions may not change on a single short trip.

trophies.name: Low Tide
trophies.description: Find a quiet stretch of shore away from the busiest beaches.
trophies.hint: Follow smaller roads to the water rather than stopping at the best-known boardwalk.

trophies.name: Backseat Driver
trophies.description: Complete a long ride without taking the wheel yourself.
trophies.hint: Let a companion handle the trip and avoid interrupting the ride with a character swap.

trophies.name: Biscayne Bound
trophies.description: Make the full trip from the city edge to the southern coast.
trophies.hint: Start outside the center and follow a continuous route instead of fast travel.

trophies.name: Keep the Change
trophies.description: Build a modest nest egg from the state's everyday opportunities.
trophies.hint: Mix story payouts with side jobs; avoid spending every windfall as soon as it arrives.

trophies.name: Rising Signal
trophies.description: Tune in to every station available on the road.
trophies.hint: Cycle through the dial while driving in different parts of the state.

trophies.name: The Long Weekend
trophies.description: Try a little of everything the leisure spots have to offer.
trophies.hint: Look for activity icons near marinas, courts, bars, and neighborhood parks.

trophies.name: Welcome to Vice
trophies.description: Set foot in the city after the journey south.
trophies.hint: Play through the opening sequence and follow the first route into town.

trophies.name: Two to a Car
trophies.description: Complete a mission with both leads working together.
trophies.hint: Continue the main thread until the story places the pair on the same job.

trophies.name: First Payday
trophies.description: Collect the first proper cut from a risky piece of work.
trophies.hint: Finish the opening job chain and check the money total afterward.

trophies.name: No Scratch
trophies.description: Finish a pursuit without damaging the vehicle you brought in.
trophies.hint: Use a wider route and lift off the accelerator before tight turns.

trophies.name: Smooth Arrival
trophies.description: Reach a destination in a vehicle with its original paint intact.
trophies.hint: Avoid crowded roads and take the last block slowly.

trophies.name: Island Hopper
trophies.description: Set foot on several islands beyond the mainland.
trophies.hint: Check boat launches and bridges for routes to small offshore map shapes.

trophies.name: Shoreline Mile
trophies.description: Follow a continuous stretch of beach on foot.
trophies.hint: Pick a coast with room to walk and stay out of the surf where the ground breaks.

trophies.name: Night Market
trophies.description: Visit a lively street market after dark.
trophies.hint: Return to shopping streets at night; some districts feel different after sunset.

trophies.name: Over the Keys
trophies.description: Cross a long bridge without leaving the roadway.
trophies.hint: Choose a steady car and avoid weaving through traffic for the entire crossing.

trophies.name: Fresh Coat
trophies.description: Give a vehicle a complete visual refresh.
trophies.hint: Visit a customization shop and change at least one exterior option.

trophies.name: Under the Hood
trophies.description: Improve a vehicle's handling or performance.
trophies.hint: Use a workshop menu to fit a mechanical upgrade, not only a cosmetic part.

trophies.name: Borrowed Time
trophies.description: Escape a search by ducking out of sight before the clock runs down.
trophies.hint: Break the line of sight, leave the main road, and wait somewhere quiet.

trophies.name: Easy Does It
trophies.description: Lose pursuit without a collision.
trophies.hint: Prioritize space and clean turns over top speed when the search begins.

trophies.name: Long Sightline
trophies.description: Make a difficult shot from a distant vantage point.
trophies.hint: Find a clear view, steady your aim, and use a target that is not moving.

trophies.name: Steady Hands
trophies.description: Complete a short combat encounter without missing a shot.
trophies.hint: Wait for a clear target and use controlled shots instead of holding the trigger.

trophies.name: Off the Clock
trophies.description: Spend a full in-game evening away from the main job.
trophies.hint: Pick an activity or quiet spot and let the day-night cycle move along.

trophies.name: Good Neighbor
trophies.description: Help a stranger with a problem on the roadside.
trophies.hint: Slow down near people calling for help; optional encounters can be easy to pass by.

trophies.name: Small Mercies
trophies.description: Resolve a tense encounter without escalating it.
trophies.hint: Try a calm response when the conversation gives you a choice.

trophies.name: Local Color
trophies.description: Spend time in a neighborhood far from the tourist strip.
trophies.hint: Take side streets inland and explore beyond the bright waterfront blocks.

trophies.name: Morning Coffee
trophies.description: Start a day with a stop at a neighborhood cafe.
trophies.hint: Look for small storefronts when the city wakes up; not every venue is marked.

trophies.name: Salt Air
trophies.description: Spend a calm moment beside the water at sunrise.
trophies.hint: Find an east-facing shoreline and arrive before the day gets busy.

trophies.name: Swamp Lights
trophies.description: Explore a wetland trail after the sun has gone down.
trophies.hint: Follow marked paths into the marsh and bring a light source if the area is dark.

trophies.name: Quiet Current
trophies.description: Travel down a river without beaching your boat.
trophies.hint: Ease off near bends and watch for narrow channels between the banks.

trophies.name: Dockside Deal
trophies.description: Finish a job that begins or ends at a working marina.
trophies.hint: Keep an eye on mission prompts around the harbor after the main story opens up.

trophies.name: Highway Hum
trophies.description: Hold a high cruising speed for a complete highway stretch.
trophies.hint: Choose a clear section of road and stay centered rather than weaving.

trophies.name: Two Wheels
trophies.description: Keep a motorcycle balanced through a clean corner.
trophies.hint: Brake before the turn, then lean gently as you accelerate out.

trophies.name: Soft Landing
trophies.description: Land an aircraft safely after a short flight.
trophies.hint: Line up early and reduce speed before you reach the runway.

trophies.name: Skyline Loop
trophies.description: See the downtown skyline from a high route and return to street level.
trophies.hint: Use a rooftop access point or elevated road for a view above the busy blocks.

trophies.name: Street Circuit
trophies.description: Place first in a neighborhood road race.
trophies.hint: Learn the turns before pushing speed; a clean line beats a risky shortcut.

trophies.name: Dust and Glory
trophies.description: Finish an off-road event without leaving the course.
trophies.hint: Ease over rough ground and follow the route markers through the widest path.

trophies.name: Fair-Weather Friend
trophies.description: Share a recreational activity with a companion.
trophies.hint: Invite a friendly contact when an optional activity is available.

trophies.name: One More Round
trophies.description: Win a small local tournament.
trophies.hint: Practice the activity once before entering its competitive version.

trophies.name: Kept Your Word
trophies.description: Complete an optional contact's full chain of favors.
trophies.hint: Return to contacts after a chapter; their next request may not appear immediately.

trophies.name: After Hours
trophies.description: Take a late-night job that never appears on the main route.
trophies.hint: Check the phone and map after dark for optional work.

trophies.name: Paper Trail
trophies.description: Collect a set of scattered documents tied to local history.
trophies.hint: Search desks, noticeboards, and out-of-the-way rooms in places you revisit.

trophies.name: Postcard Pile
trophies.description: Photograph a collection of notable places.
trophies.hint: Take a picture at a landmark from more than one region, not only downtown.

trophies.name: Odd Hours
trophies.description: Find a hidden detail that only appears at a particular time.
trophies.hint: Revisit unusual landmarks at night and in daylight.

trophies.name: Wildlife Watcher
trophies.description: Spot several kinds of animals in their natural habitats.
trophies.hint: Move quietly through wetlands, open fields, and shorelines; each favors a different place.

trophies.name: Good Eye
trophies.description: Capture a rare scene with the in-game camera.
trophies.hint: Keep the camera ready during unusual weather and busy city moments.

trophies.name: Tape Trader
trophies.description: Find a handful of music recordings hidden around the state.
trophies.hint: Search record shops and homes connected to the music scene.

trophies.name: Full Tank
trophies.description: Refuel at a roadside station and continue the same trip.
trophies.hint: Pull into a service stop during a long drive rather than ending the journey first.

trophies.name: One of Each
trophies.description: Try a vehicle from every broad class.
trophies.hint: Keep a note of cars, bikes, utility vehicles, and aircraft you have driven or flown.

trophies.name: Custom Fit
trophies.description: Personalize an outfit from head to toe.
trophies.hint: Change several clothing slots at a shop or wardrobe before heading out.

trophies.name: Home Again
trophies.description: Return to a safehouse after a long trip across the map.
trophies.hint: Mark a home location before setting off so the return leg is easy to track.

trophies.name: Wrong Turn, Right Place
trophies.description: Discover an unexpected point of interest away from a marked route.
trophies.hint: Take an unmarked road through the countryside and watch for small landmarks.

trophies.name: Clear Channel
trophies.description: Listen to a complete broadcast without changing stations.
trophies.hint: Pick a station you enjoy and leave it on through a full drive.

trophies.name: Quiet Exit
trophies.description: Finish a job and leave the area without drawing a search.
trophies.hint: Use the route the mission gives you and avoid unnecessary stops on the way out.

trophies.name: Moving Target
trophies.description: Complete a timed challenge while remaining in motion.
trophies.hint: Learn the course first, then keep a steady pace through its marked sections.

trophies.name: Story in the Streets
trophies.description: Notice a public event unfolding without a mission marker.
trophies.hint: Pause near crowds and listen; background scenes can become small discoveries.

trophies.name: Island Time
trophies.description: Spend a full afternoon at a quiet island retreat.
trophies.hint: Arrive before midday and explore the whole small island on foot.

trophies.name: Last Light
trophies.description: Watch the sun set from the far edge of the state.
trophies.hint: Reach an open western view before evening and wait for the horizon to change.

trophies.name: Leonida Loop
trophies.description: Make a complete road trip around the mainland.
trophies.hint: Use the outer highways and keep a route that returns to your starting region.

trophies.name: Ledger Closed
trophies.description: Complete every optional activity in one category.
trophies.hint: Use the game's checklist if available, then revisit the map for any unmarked icon.

trophies.name: No Shortcuts
trophies.description: Win a race without using a route that leaves the course.
trophies.hint: Follow every checkpoint in order; a patient clean run beats a missed gate.

trophies.name: Last Call
trophies.description: Answer a contact's final message after the main story ends.
trophies.hint: Check the phone and return to familiar contacts once the credits have rolled.
